title: The Primer of Small Debts
summary: A first primer on feeling the thin thread of debt between a harm done and the one who did it and plucking it for a small return.

title: A Handbook of Returned Blows
summary: A handbook on taking a light blow and sending a small echo of it back to the one who struck.

title: The Weighing Hand Workbook
summary: A workbook on the open hand that weighs the harm a person has lately done and feels what they carry because of it.

title: Exercises of the Even Measure
summary: Exercises in meeting every blow with exactly its measure so that no more and no less than was given is returned.
